title: Turso
description: Distributed SQLite database for the edge powered by libSQL, offering sub-millisecond query latency worldwide with multi-tenant database branching.
features: Global read replicas across 30+ regions with sub-9ms edge response
Database-per-user multi-tenancy architecture scaling to 10,000+ DBs
Native libSQL driver compatible with Drizzle ORM, Prisma, and Kysely
Branching workflow mirroring Git pull request environments
Embedded replicas in Node.js/Go for true zero-latency reads
pros: Lightweight SQLite simplicity without connection pooling bottlenecks
cons: Writes route back to primary region, introducing write latency
SQLite concurrency limits under extremely heavy write loads
targetAudience: Edge-first Next.js, Cloudflare Workers, and multi-tenant SaaS developers.
